name: Intellivision Flashback
summary: The Intellivision Flashback Game Console features 60 games for the classic Intellivision platform. Manufactured in 2014, this black console with a sleek design includes a component RCA connectivity option and has a storage capacity of 32 MB. With a resolution under 480p, this home console from the Intellivision brand offers a nostalgic gaming experience for fans of retro video games.
